xlk.now: Tech is topping on narrowing leadership. XLK is RS rank #1 and well above its 200-day, but the cycle-position oscillator has rolled from euphoric highs and the advance is carried by a shrinking set of AI mega-caps. The setup is late-cycle distribution, not a fresh breakout.

2022-10-12.title: The genAI bull run
2022-10-12.body: From the October-2022 bear-market low, XLK more than doubled into mid-2024 as ChatGPT ignited a generative-AI capex super-cycle. Hyperscalers raced to buy accelerators, NVDA/AVGO re-rated violently, and falling inflation plus a Fed pivot-in-sight re-expanded multiples across software and semis.

2024-07-10.title: Yen-carry unwind air-pocket
2024-07-10.body: A sharp but brief ~17% drawdown into early August 2024 as a BoJ hike unwound the yen carry trade, a weak payrolls print sparked a growth scare, and the most-crowded AI longs were forced to de-gross. It was a positioning flush, not a fundamental break — the uptrend resumed within weeks.

2025-02-19.title: DeepSeek + tariff shock
2025-02-19.body: A ~26% slide as DeepSeek's cheap-inference claims questioned the AI capex ROI thesis, then the April 2025 reciprocal-tariff salvo hit hardware supply chains and risk appetite. Highest-multiple AI names corrected hardest into the early-April low.

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff-pause melt-up
2025-04-08.body: Off the April low, a tariff pause and resilient hyperscaler capex guides drove a powerful ~70% recovery to new highs by late October. Memory pricing tightened into an undersupplied market and AI-infrastructure spend kept beating, re-rating semis and software back to euphoria.

2025-10-29.title: AI-bubble wobble & valuation reset
2025-10-29.body: A ~16% reset from the October highs as breadth narrowed, Broadcom's refusal to raise its AI outlook triggered a sharp wipeout, and a hotter inflation tape flipped the Fed to a hiking bias — compressing the long-duration multiples that had powered the melt-up.

2026-03-30.title: Spring relief rally
2026-03-30.body: A recovery off the March-2026 low as the Iran/Hormuz oil tail unwound on a ceasefire and AI mega-caps found support, but the advance has narrowed and the cycle is re-approaching the highs on thinner participation.
